review.en: Cohen was already a published poet and novelist in his thirties when he made this debut, produced by John Simon. Nylon-string guitar, a narrow voice and sparse added textures leave room for the words. Suzanne, Sisters of Mercy and So Long, Marianne became standards of the singer-songwriter era and gave the form a new literary weight.
review.zh: 科恩出这张首专时已三十多岁，是出版过诗集和小说的作家，制作人是约翰·西蒙。尼龙弦吉他、音域不宽的嗓子和稀疏的点缀，把空间留给词句。《Suzanne》《Sisters of Mercy》《So Long, Marianne》成了唱作时代的经典，也让这一形式多了文学的分量。
